explanations.trigger_explanation: A pipeline or utility crossing across Jefferson County Drainage District No. 6 ditches, easements, or other district facilities commonly triggers the district pipeline/utility permit process.

known_unknowns: Board approval, fees, insurance, and engineering review are project-specific and should be confirmed during intake.
advisories: Additional review recommended for horizontal directional drilling, open-cut crossings, and maintenance actions because amendments can be required.
notes: Confidence tier 2 because the district publishes an active permit application and forms portal, but exact approval conditions are district- and project-specific.
